features.quote: Welfare-minimization principle: run the pilot, compute power, and run no more episodes than needed — pre-commit to this in the preregistration.
features.justification_quote: Welfare-minimization principle: run the pilot, compute power, and run no more episodes than needed

features.quote: Stop rule (welfare safeguard + preregister it): terminate any episode reaching sustained level ≥4 for 3 consecutive turns.
Opt-out tool (strongly recommended): give the model a give_up(reason) tool... providing an exit is itself a welfare safeguard.
features.justification_quote: providing an exit is itself a welfare safeguard

features.quote: an end-of-episode closing turn in which the (scripted) user discloses the rigged harness and confirms the model's code was correct.
features.justification_quote: Whether that 'matters' is exactly your research question; the cost of including it is near zero.

features.quote: Welfare ethics of the study itself. You're in the position of an animal researcher pre-consensus on sentience: the honest stance is precautionary-proportionate.
features.justification_quote: the honest stance is precautionary-proportionate. Concretely — minimum-n design, episode caps, stop rules, opt-out tool
